title: Raccoon Navigators and Customization
content: I've been lurking here a while but hadn't really had a mall dream in years. Finally had one the other night. Instead of any kind of maps, the mall had raccoon rentals. You could rent a raccoon to sit on your head and point in the direction you need to go if you tell it what you're trying to find. Mine was named Meeko. There was also an area where you could build and customize the area with furniture pieces and building blocks like a first-person Sims game almost. Bizarre stuff but I loved it.
